Staff Attendance

Authoritative daily check-in, check-out, biometric device synchronization, attendance validation, correction requests, and monthly muster rolls.

Authoritative Attendance Policy & Validation Protocol:
Official school working hours: 08:30 AM – 04:30 PM (Morning shift from 06:45 AM for Transport; Office from 08:00 AM). Arrivals after the 10-minute grace period (08:40 AM) are automatically flagged as Late Arrival with calculated duration. The system strictly validates duplicate entries and permitted time ranges. Any correction submitted by staff or authorized managers requires designated review by the Principal or Administrative Officer with full audit trail retention.

Institutional Leave Policy, Limits & Approval Governance

Regulated under Andhra Pradesh State Education Department (SCERT) Service Norms • Academic Year 2026–27

Casual Leave (CL) 12 Days / Year

Available for unintended domestic exigencies. Max 3 consecutive working days allowed at a stretch. Must be applied 24 hours in advance.

Medical / Sick Leave (ML) 10 Days / Year

For personal health recovery. Requires Medical Certificate from a Registered Medical Practitioner (RMP) if absence exceeds 2 days. Accruable.

Earned Leave (EL) 15 Days / Year

Eligible for confirmed staff with > 1 year continuous service. Requires minimum 15 days prior sanction by Principal Smt. Gorle Varalakshmi.

On Duty (OD) Leave Max 15 Days

Sanctioned for AP Board Spot Valuation, State Science Fairs, NCC/Sports escorts, and SCERT pedagogical seminars. Full salary credited.

Statutory Department Concurrency & Academic Continuity Rule

To prevent curriculum disruptions, no more than one faculty member from the same academic department (e.g. Mathematics, Physical Science, English) may take casual leave on the same working day without special dispensation from Principal Smt. Gorle Varalakshmi. All substitutions must be finalized on the Substitution Planner before 08:15 AM.
